required.name: git
required.why: create and switch the feature worktree for the ticket

optional.name: atlassian
optional.why: read the ticket's acceptance criteria when no context brief is supplied
optional.install: connect the Atlassian MCP or use the acli CLI
optional.degrade: ask the user to paste the ticket's ACs

optional.name: hindsight
optional.why: recall prior decisions and gotchas for the ticket's area

optional.name: gh
optional.why: detect the MR/PR number for the branch on GitHub
optional.degrade: omit the MR number from the spawned session title

optional.name: glab
optional.why: detect the MR number for the branch on GitLab
optional.degrade: omit the MR number from the spawned session title
